classification.difficultyReason: Calculate missing angles and sketch suitable quadrilaterals, including a non-convex quadrilateral.

content.prompt: In each part, three angles of a quadrilateral are given. Calculate the size of the fourth angle of the quadrilateral. Sketch a quadrilateral with these angle sizes.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}x&=360^{\circ}-(90^{\circ}+90^{\circ}+150^{\circ})\\x&=360^{\circ}-330^{\circ}\\x&=30^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
